text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In order to encourage motivation and
self-improvement among the<n>Umamusume, the
academy is holding<n>a large-scale scrimmage.

As the day of the event rolls around,<n>Symboli
Rudolf, the head of the<n>organization committee,
looks on with<n>anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Spirits are positively stratospheric.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: See for yourself, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf gestures to the track,<n>where the
participating Umamusume<n>are eagerly getting
ready.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Spe! Scrimmage or not, I'll<n>kick your butt!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's what you think! You and<n>everyone else are
gonna eat my dust!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're lookin' pretty pale there,<n>Scarlet. Don't tell
me all the<n>competition's got you nervous?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
As if! I don't care how many racers I<n>have to beat,
I'll prove I'm number<n>one!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is spirited today. They have<n>fire in their
eyes and dreams in their<n>hearts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That fire will lead them to a brighter<n>future. Such is
my constant hope.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And today, my job as student council<n>president is
to stoke those flames.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Which is why I wish to ask you for<n>advice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How can I best encourage them to<n>blaze their own
trails?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hah. I suppose the answer was<n>obvious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We Umamusume are born to run. It is<n>the way by
which we show the world<n>our true selves.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well, then. I shall demonstrate to<n>them what it
looks like to have truly<n>mastered body and mind.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf goes on to wow the<n>crowd and
competition alike with an<n>untouchable performance
in the first<n>race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That... That was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That was crazy... but it sure got me<n>fired up!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to thank all of you once again<n>for gathering
here today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As fellow Umamusume of the Twinkle<n>Series...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
May we continue to raise one another<n>up as we
strive to pursue our<n>dreams!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's inspiring<n>performance lights a
new fire in the<n>hearts of her fellow Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She's certainly succeeded in leading<n>by example.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A sound idea. Ideals mean nothing if<n>not spoken
aloud—only once put into<n>words can others look to
them for<n>guidance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall give them a speech to remind<n>them of the
future we all strive<n>toward.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At the opening ceremony, after<n>delivering her
welcoming address and<n>going over a few
guidelines...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Last but not least, I would like to<n>remind you all of
one thing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We all race for the sake of something<n>that we hold
dear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Something that we each hold deep<n>within
ourselves. Hope, perhaps, or<n>ambition, or even
yearning.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's reason is different, yet<n>equally noble.
And when we take to<n>the track with them in our
hearts...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Those who watch us are inspired to<n>dream.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf's words resound<n>across the track.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: We... inspire people to dream?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... Now I'm fired up!

I'd like to thank all of you for<n>attending today. I
hope to see you<n>compete, collaborate, challenge
one<n>another...

And forge a path together toward our<n>shining
future!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's worn the mantle of leader well<n>today,
offering an ideal for the others<n>to chase.
